200.title: US resumes immigrant visa processing for Hungary, Poland as pause remains elsewhere
200.summary: AFP-Yonhap WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump's administration resumed processing immigrant visa applications from Hungary and Poland last week while maintaining a temporary pause on immigrant visa appointments elsewhere, four people familiar with the matter said.
200.body: AFP-Yonhap WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump's administration resumed processing immigrant visa applications from Hungary and Poland last week while maintaining a temporary pause on immigrant visa appointments elsewhere, four people familiar with the matter said. A State Department spokesperson did not comment on why it resumed immigrant visa processing for Hungary and Poland. In January, the State Department said it was temporarily suspending the processing of immigrant visas — which allow people to move permanently to the United States — in 75 countries where applicants were "at a high risk for becoming a public charge." After a federal judge ruled against the visa ban, the State Department paused immigrant visa interviews at all of its global missions while rolling out a new training program.

400.title: Canada looks beyond the US as Ottawa targets Poland with nuclear technology, uranium and LNG in major trad
400.summary: Canada is turning to Poland as it looks for new opportunities in energy and infrastructure, with Ottawa pitching nuclear technology, uranium supplies and liquefied natural gas as part of a broader effort to expand trade beyond the United States.Canadian Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu said Ottawa has held discussions with Polish officials about potentially helping build the country's second nuclear power plant.
400.body: Canada is turning to Poland as it looks for new opportunities in energy and infrastructure, with Ottawa pitching nuclear technology, uranium supplies and liquefied natural gas as part of a broader effort to expand trade beyond the United States.Canadian Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu said Ottawa has held discussions with Polish officials about potentially helping build the country's second nuclear power plant. The project is part of Poland's long-term plan to replace some of its ageing and carbon-intensive coal generation with nuclear energy.Canada could now compete with both American and French interests for a role in Poland's next nuclear project, Bloomberg News reported.Sidhu described the discussions as encouraging after meeting Poland's energy and finance ministers.
